definitions.explanation: A ceremony held at the beginning of the school year to welcome new students.

examples.japanese: {入学式|にゅうがくしき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧4⟦{月|がつ}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The entrance ceremony is held in April.

examples.japanese: {入学式|にゅうがくしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席：02084_shusseki⟧。
examples.english: Parents also attend the entrance ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入学式|にゅうがくしき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{盛大|せいだい}→盛大：13644_seidai⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The university entrance ceremony was very grand.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧ (entering school) + ⟦{式|しき}→式：02000_shiki⟧ (ceremony). A formal event marking the start of a student's time at a new school.

TIMING:
Held in April at the start of the Japanese academic year. Often coincides with ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧ (cherry blossom) season, making it an iconic spring event.

ATTIRE:
Students wear formal attire or school uniforms. ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧ (parents) typically attend and also dress formally.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {入学式|にゅうがくしき}: entrance ceremony (beginning)
- ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧: graduation ceremony (ending)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {入学式|にゅうがくしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席：02084_shusseki⟧: to attend the entrance ceremony
- {入学式|にゅうがくしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧: the entrance ceremony is held
